page.overview:
Who is Anap Ree-Di?

Anap Ree-Di was a female individual who was a Jedi Knight during the Clone Wars. Ree-Di's connection to the Force allowed her to have a special relationship to historical objects and the ripples they created in history. During the war, Ree-Di traveled aboard the Arquitens-class light cruiser Stellar Rise as they transported artifacts from the High Republic Era. During the voyage, the light cruiser was infiltrated by Separatist Supreme Commander General Grievous, who confronted Ree-Di. While Grievous believed he had the upper hand after having taken the bridge with little resistance, Ree-Di was eventually able to lull him into a trap that ejected Grievous from the ship.
